يكتفيا (form VIII)
# يَكْتَفِيَا (yaktafiyā) /jak.ta.fi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
# يُكْتَفَيَا (yuktafayā) /juk.ta.fa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
